description: Protocols ranked by trading volume, updated daily: kind dexs (spot DEX volume), options (options notional) or aggregators (DEX aggregator volume). Per protocol the 24h, 7d, 30d and 1y volume, the 1d/7d/30d change, its chains and category, with totals over the selection, 50 per page. With chain, each protocol's volume on that chain is chain_volume_24h_usd and the ranking and 24h total are that chain's (no 7d or 30d total). Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

category.description: A DefiLlama category, case-insensitive (Dexs, Derivatives, DEXAggregator, Options).

chain.description: A chain, by DefiLlama's chain key or name, case-insensitive (ethereum, base, arbitrum, bsc, solana, avax, hyperliquid).

sort_order.description: desc for the highest first, asc for the lowest.

name: volumes
title: DEX, options and aggregator volumes
